title: Leap generators for composition schemes
summary: Leap generators have been introduced in [Duchon et al.'04] for exact-size random generation of structures in a class of the form $\mathcal{C}=\mathrm{Seq}(\mathcal{B})$ (sequence construction), in the supercritical case. We extend these generators to supercritical composition schemes $\mathcal{C}=\mathcal{A}\circ\mathcal{B}$.
